definitions.explanation: Characterized by being sensible, reliable, and avoiding unnecessary risks; down-to-earth and practical.

examples.japanese: {堅実|けんじつ}な{経営|けいえい}。
{彼|かれ}は{堅実|けんじつ}な{人柄|ひとがら}で{信頼|しんらい}されている。
examples.english: He is trusted for his reliable character.

examples.japanese: {堅実|けんじつ}な{経営|けいえい}のおかげで、{会社|かいしゃ}は{不況|ふきょう}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた。
examples.english: Thanks to solid management, the company survived the recession.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{堅実|けんじつ}な{経営|けいえい} - solid management
・{堅実|けんじつ}な{人柄|ひとがら} - reliable character
・{堅実|けんじつ}な{生活|せいかつ} - sensible lifestyle
・{堅実|けんじつ}に{働|はたら}く - to work steadily
・{堅実|けんじつ}さ - reliability (noun form)

POSITIVE CONNOTATION:
A complimentary term suggesting someone who is dependable, avoids risky behavior, and makes sound decisions.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{着実|ちゃくじつ} - steady, reliable (emphasizes consistent progress)
・{確実|かくじつ} - certain, sure
